newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, Flughafen sags.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, Flughafen sags.

text.p: 1410 GMT - Austrian shares end a shade lower on Monday with trading volumes generally low apart from vibrant activity in Vienna airport operator Flughafen.
Market taking wait-and-see stance ahead of FOMC meeting on Tuesday, traders said.
* ATX index down 0.07 percent at 1,215.69 points after trading within tight range of 1,211.20 to 1,220.35.
* 11 ATX shares higher, nine lower, one unchanged.
* April ATX future down two points at 1,214 on turnover of 632 contracts.
* Top gainer Radex, up 1.91 percent at 426 schillings.

* Leading decliner Flughafen, down 2.49 percent to 549. Stock was also the most actively traded on turnover of more than 200,000 lots. "There are rumours that (one of the two) chief executives has resigned," said one trader. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
